pages.text: Bondknot is a wood type obtained primarily as part of $(l:structures/family_tree)$(c)$(o)Family Trees$() or by altering any Wood in an Alteration Catalyst. Just as any other wood type, it can be crafted into Stairs, Slabs, Fences, and so on.

There's also a special variant: the Popping Bondknot Wood, which can only appear on Family trees. These cannot be harvested and generate $(l:materials/crystallized_bonds)$(c)$(o)Crystallized Bonds$() on a regular basis.
